critique: The delivered core is an exact fixed-budget submodularity-ratio frontier over the stated Gaussian sparse-margin class, with a matching limiting construction and the resulting generic greedy certificate. The phrase "exact certified factor" must not be read as an exact worst-case greedy-value approximation ratio: the construction approaches the submodularity ratio only through vanishing endpoint contrast, and no law is shown to attain the induced greedy-value factor at fixed signal. The empirical greedy result is conditional on an unspecified uniform endpoint-error event, while the inference additions establish coverage but provide neither interval-length control nor evidence that the whole-class projection interval is informative. The Lindeberg–Feller leaf is invoked without the precise bibliographic theorem citation required for an external result, and the closest-literature discussion does not compare theorem hypotheses and conclusions closely enough to substantiate the claimed separation from existing Gaussian and weak-submodularity results. These limitations constrain the package below a leading-journal headline score but do not undo the proved sharp Gaussian approximation frontier.
